tei:div.tei:p: thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las/ gu ru hor sog dmag bzlog che mchog drag po'i khyad par gyi phrin las las tshogs dang bcas pa yid bzhin rdo rje'i rdzong chen bzhugs/

ye shes rdo rje'i gur chen pos/ /'gro kun srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las/ /skyobs mdzad gu ru che ba'i mchog /btud nas de sgrub phrin las spel/ /thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i man ngag bcu gsum gyi dang po gu ru hor sog dmag bzlog gi las byang btang ba la/ sbyor ba shom bkod ni/ gnas khang yid dang mthun par byi dor gtsang sbra byas pa'i mdun du 'bru nag gi tshom bu gtso 'khor lnga bkod pa'i steng 'phrul stegs la/ gu ru che mchog gi dpal gtor 'khor bzhi mtheb kyus bskor ba dang*/ bka' srung dregs pa'i sde dpon dmar gtor dpung rong 'khor sum cu can sogs mchod dgos gang yod dang*/ chad brtan/ sman raka nyer spyod/ dkar bgegs/ rol mo'i rigs sogs 'du bya'o/ /dbang dang 'brel na gzhung mthun sku dang*/ sngags byang*/ me long*/ zor gtor dar gdugs rgyan ldan/ zor chas phyogs bsdus kyang bkod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las rim las byang dngos/ dmag bzlog /dmag gi gnod pa srung ba'i las rim gsum/ dang po la'ang brgyad las/ thog mar dam tshig gi 'khor lo bskyed pa ni/ chos rnams dmigs med ngang nyid las: rdo rje pha lam las grub pa'i: gzhal yas khang gi nang nyid du: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i lte ba la: pad nyi dregs pa bsgyel ba'i steng : bdag nyid rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal: smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas pas kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon dril bu: dbu skra gyen brdzes dur khrod chas: zhabs gnyis dor stabs me klong bzhugs: phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi la: shar du ya ma rā dza mthing : 'khor lo dang ni thun khrag 'dzin: lho ru skos rje drang dkar mthing : rdo rje dang ni bdud zhags 'dzin: nub tu yaṃ shud dmar po ni: mdung dar dang ni btsan zhags 'dzin: byang du gang ba bzang po nag: be con dang ni nad rkyal 'dzin: kun kyang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: rab 'byams khro bo'i sprin phung 'phro:

gnas gsum rdo rje'i 'bru gsum mtshan: 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs bstim: gnyis pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs pa nas drug pa bstod pa'i bar spyi chings ltar la/ bstod pa'i khyad par ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos ka dag chos sku'i ngang nyid las: bde chen lhun grub 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje'i rig rtsal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar: sku gsum bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'od gsal lhan skyes ye shes gcig nyid las: rig rtsal ma 'gags 'gro 'dul dpal du shar: bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam nor bu ltar: gdul bya mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re ba skong : hor sogs dmag bzlog gu ru che ba'i mchog: gang 'dul der snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i tshul: sku lnga mtshan brgyad rnam 'phrul bcu gsum sogs: bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhi: gdug can mthar byed mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin: 'jigs dang sdug bsngal bar chad thams cad 'joms: dpal chen mthar byed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzhan yang phyogs dus rgyal sras rig pa 'dzin: yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs: sdug bsngal kun sel dngos grub char rgyun 'bebs: chos kyi dbyings nas rol la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdun pa bzlas pa la/ dbang dang las sbyor skabs dzap khang dbye dgos pas/ dang po bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe sarba ma hā gu ru phaṭa dzaḥ rdo rje'i sngags kyis sgra gdangs kyis: ye shes dkyil 'khor mdun du dbye: mi re 'dab 'byor tshul nyid du: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs par bsam: gnyis pa dzab bskul ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ snying po byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du: ye shes sgyu mar rol pa'i lha tshogs rnams: mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam tshig rjes dgongs la: byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol: gsum pa bzlas pa dngos ni/ gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng :

hūm̐ la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: de las 'od 'phros dregs pa bzhi'i: thugs srog la phog dregs pa rnams: sngon gyi dam tshig dran nas su: sprul pa bsam mi khyab pa yis: g.yo 'khrugs dmag dpung bzlog par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐:ya du tsa sha bh+yo bzlog: ces ci nus bzla/ dbyangs gsal rten snying lan gsum gyis nus pa spel/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa bla ma'i lha tshogs la: phyi nang gsang ba dzab bsnyen mchod pa 'bul: yon tan rjes dran rdo rje'i glu yis bstod: nyams chags kun bshags mchog thun dngos grub stsol: ma hā a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: yig brgyas nongs pa bshags/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs ka nas: rang 'dra'i sku dang 'od zer tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i spro bsdu yis: gang 'dod don kun lhun grub gyur: zhes mos la gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub tshang ba dang*/ hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: gu ru lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par the tshom med: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ces grangs bsags/ gtor bzlog dang ma 'brel na rjes rim gtor bsngos tshogs mchod spyi chings ltar mthar dbyung ngo*/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa khyad par gyi las sbyor ni/ hor sog dmag dpung bzlog pa'i las mtha' brtsams par 'dod na dang po sbyor ba'i gshom bkod ni/ gnas khang drag po'i chas kyis brgyan par/ gzhung mthun sku rten mdun las dkyil stegs bur ma traṃ gyi gzugs bris pa'i lte bar drag po'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar gru gsum mdun bstan yaḥyis mtshan pa'i mañji'i steng 'bru nag dug khrag chang gis sbrus pa'i dmar gtor thog mdel srin zhal gyi dbyibs can/

phyogs bzhir 'khor rang 'dra bzhi/ bar rnams khrag kong bcad kha phyir bstan gyis ltems par dar nag gi gdugs rtse mo kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum pas mtshan pa sku tsaka dang bcas pa la/ mtshe rtsang sha khrag ba su tas brgyan pa/ drag po'i nyer spyod dang sman raka bcas bsham/ zhar byung mtshon srung gi las sbyor sgrub na zor mdun drag gtor gru gsum 'khor gsum can gyi nang*/ rtsa sngags badz+ra gu ru'i mthar/ ya du tsa sha 'chang ba po la mtshon gyi 'jigs pa thams cad rak+ṣaḥ zhes pa grangs gang dgos bris la chos sman byug /dbu nas dril te na bza' mdog gang rnyed dam/ tshon skud sna lngas dkri dbu mjug mi log par byas te gtor ma'i nang gzhug tu bcug /bzlog gtor 'og lcags hom du liṅga/ gdab phur/ phyag rgya bzhi/ dbye sgro/ byad thag sngo dmar/ dug khrag thun rdzas/ gser skyems sogs 'du byas la/ gnyis pa rten bskyed ni/ bdag bskyed gu ru che mchog gi phrin las bzlas pa stong tshig bcas btang la/ rang nyid gu ru che mchog thugs ka nas: ye shes lcags kyu 'bar ba rab 'phros pas: mtha' bzhi'i dmag dang dam sri nyon mongs dug: ma traṃ la thim bsgral bya'i mtshan nyid ldan: slar yang thugs nas 'phros pa'i mtshon cha'i char: ser ltar bab pas ma traṃ khog pa zhig: 'byung ba rim brtsegs me rlung 'khrugs pa'i klong : dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang du bsam: ma traṃ ru tra pra be sha ya phaṭa: a be sha ya aḥ baṃ ti ra tiṣ+ṭha bh+rūm̐: de dbus gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa: lte ba mi g.yo yangs shing rgya che la: rtsibs rnams me rlung dang bcas shugs drag 'khor: sprul pa'i khro bo nyi zer rdul ltar 'tshubs: dbus su ya ma rā dza sku mdog mthing: g.yas pas 'khor lo g.yon pas thun khrag 'phen: g.yas su bdud po rkos rje drang dkar mthing: g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas bdud zhags 'dzin: g.yon du gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po nag: g.yas pas be con 'phyar zhing g.yon nad rkyal:

mdun du btsan rgyal yam shud dmar po ni: g.yas pas mdung dar g.yon pas btsan zhags 'phen: rgyab tu dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu rnams: rang rang sde dang 'khor g.yog bcas pa gsal: gzhan yang ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi: chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud ma ning ste: dregs pa sde brgyad gnas yul zhing skyong ba'i: ma mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro rlung ltar 'tshubs: kun kyang khro gtum 'bar 'phro dgra bgegs gshed: 'khor ba ru ldog chos nyid zhe la gnon: srid pa gting dkrugs ye shes dbyings su rol: 'bar ba chen po'i phyag rgya lham mer gsal: snang stong zung 'jug ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor lhun grub cing : ye shes rigs lnga'i dbang mchog rdzogs par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥ gsum pa spyan 'dren ni/ zhing gi g.yab mo dang rkang gling bshugs glu thod rnga'i sgras bskul te/ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings mi ri 'bar ba dang : dbang drag pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: dus gsum bde gshegasabla ma yi dam lha: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs rnams kun: sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i gu ru che ba'i mchog: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang mtha' dmag 'byung po'i gshed: 'khor gyi dregs pa sde bzhi sde dpon bcas: gtso 'khor sprul pa las mkhan skur bzhengs la: dur khrod drag po'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ aḥ ya du tsa sha sa pa ri wā ra e a ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhi pa bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum e yi klong : tsakra 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su: gu ru che mchog 'khor dang bcas: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: drag po'i mthu rtsal gcig bsdus pa: gu ru che mchog he ru ka:

'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ drug pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: dur khrod drag po'i gzhal med khang chen po: rdo rje 'dzin kyang 'jigs pa'i pho brang du: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag gi mchod yon dang : dbang po'i me tog tshil gsur bdug pa'i sprin: zhun chen mar me mkhris pa'i dri chab rdzing : sha rus zhal zas rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra: byang sems dkar dmar bdud rtsi rak+ta'i mtsho: phung po ma tshang med pa'i gtor ma che: rmad du byung ba'i dam rdzas rgya chen pos: gu ru che mchog 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : dgyes par bzhes la drag po'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe nas shap+da bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta ba liṃ ta pū dza hoḥ bdun pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dur khrod drag po me rlung 'tshubs pa'i klong : dpal chen khro rgyal bdud kyi gshed chen po: sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i gu ru che ba'i mchog: khyab bdag he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: ngang nyid ye shes dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : gdug pa 'dul phyir dregs pa'i rgyal po'i tshul: sde bzhi'i tshul snang phyag rgya'i sprin 'phro ba: khrag 'thung 'khor lo'i bsgyur la phyag 'tshal bstod: ye shes rol pa'i cho 'phrul khrag 'thung lha: rigs kyi tshom bu sprul 'khor mtha' yas shing : rgyud gsum dregs pa'i dmag dpung rlung ltar 'tshubs: dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: brgyad pa bzlas pa la rtsa ba dang*/ yan lag gi bzlas pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang gi thugs las 'od 'phros pas: mdun bskyed 'khor bcas thugs rgyud bskul: gtso bo'i thugs ka'i gzi byin gyis: dregs pa'i tshogs rnams dam la gzir: ci bcol phrin las sgrub par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: ya du tsa sha bh+yo zlog: zhes bzla/ oṃ sarba duṣ+tan e dza bh+yo: zhes pa'ang cung zad bzla/ gnyis pa yan lag gi bzlas pa la gsum las/

dang po srung ba ni/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs rtse'i me rlung las: mtshon cha rnam lnga'i sprin phung 'phros: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams can kun: gzhom med srung ba'i gur du 'khṛgs: khro bo 'chol ba'i tshogs kyis gtams: ye shes drug gi dbyings su rdzogs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: ya du tsa sha dip+ta tsakra dz+nyā na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: gnyis pa bsad pa ni/ bdag gi thugs nas 'od 'phros pas: mdun gyi dregs pa las la bskul: khros 'khrugs rngams pa'i mtshon char gyis: mtha' dmag dpung kun thal bar brlag: rdo rje me yis snying bsregs shing : mtshon cha'i char 'bebs dum bur gcod: chos nyid chu yis rgyang ring khyer: bskal pa'i rlung gis rjes med gtor: bdun brgyud rigs ni thams cad kyang : ming yang med par brlag par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: ya du tsa sha mtha' dmag dgra bgegs nṛ trī mā ra ya myog rmug hur thum rbad: gsum pa bzlog pa ni/ mdun du dregs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: thugs rje khros pas 'gro 'dul phyir: 'od zer mthing nag rab 'bar ba: bskal pa 'jig pa'i me lta bu: dug mtshon nad kyi char 'bebs pa: grangs med nyi zer rdul ltar 'phros: bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba yi: mtha' dmag gdug cing gtum pa kun: rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar bskrad: rjes shul lhag ma med par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: ya du tsa sha mtha' dmag dgra bgegs nṛ tri mā ra ya myog rmug hur thum rbad: zhes bzlas mthar/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa bla ma'i sogs stong tshig mchod bstod bya/ mtshon srung bsgrub dgos na/ lcags kyi khang sgrom zur gsum 'bar ba ru: dregs pa sde bzhi nyung 'bru tsam bzhugs pa'i: sku las mtshon cha'i char 'phros pha rol pa'i: mtshon cha'i dbal bzlog nus pa ldan par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐:

ya du tsa sha dip+ta tsakra rak+ṣa: zhes sbyar ba sngags grangs 'bum phrag tu long ba dang*/ drag sngags me dpung ci nus bzlas mthar brtan bzhugs bya/ las grub nas gtor ma 'bul zhing gzungs dril bsrung bya la btags pa'o/ /skabs 'dir bka' gter srung ma spyi bye brag gi gsol mchod btang 'os gang yod dang*/ khyad par bka' srung dregs pa'i sde dpon kyi mchod bskang gal che bas/ rgyas par mos na bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi dregs pa'i sde dpon gsol mchod dang*/ mdor bsdus snying po'i tshul ni/ rang nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gis 'od zer gyis dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par gyur/ hūm̐: sngon tshe dpal chen he ru ka /spyan sngar khas blang dam bcas pa'i/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu po/ /so so'i bka' nyan pho nyar bcas/ /dam tshig gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyi/ /ma thogs rings ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /phrin las mdzad phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+taṃ e dza bh+yoḥs pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/

zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+tan e dza bh+yo sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta pū dza hoḥ ma shā a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta pū dza khā hi/ zhes sman raka stob/ oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+taṃ e dza bh+yo sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gtor ma phul/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs sogs phrin las bcol/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ sngon tshe dpal chen he ru ka'i: spyan sngar khas blang dam bcas te: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i: mthu chen dregs pa'i sde dpon ni: dbang phyug chen po u ma yum: gshin rje nag po gsod byed ma: skos rje drang dkar re ma ti: srin po glog phreng khrag mig ma: gnod sbyin me dbal mon mo nag: gza' bdud khyab 'jug gnam sman ma: klu bdud nag po yak+sha nag: shaṃ po gnam the dkar po dang : spyi bdud gu ruṃ srid pa'i rgyal: e ka dzā ṭi mgyogs byed nag: rdo rje bdud 'dul brag btsan dmar: yaṃ shud dmar po bgegs kyi rgyal: mu stegs nag po bkrag med bdud: srog bdag tshangs pa pe ha ra: sku lha gsang ba nag po che: so so'i 'khor g.yog sprul pa ni: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs bcas pa: kun kyang khro gtum bzod par dka': 'jigs pa'i gzugs la rngams pa'i skad: drag shul chen po'i gzugs 'chang ba: nyi zer rdul ltar 'tshubs pa kun: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang : sman raka bdud rtsi nyer spyod sogs: mthun rdzas 'dod rgu'i mchod pa bzhes: thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chags bshags: dregs pa sde brgyad khengs log dang : 'khon pa zlum la cho 'phrul zhi: mi mthun kun sel mthun rkyen sgrubs: mdor na yid la gang 'dod pa'i: phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod: ces las bcol la rjes rim bya'o/ /spyi chings ltar tshogs bshags pa'i bar du btang*/

bskang ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ snang srid pad+ma drwa ba'i zhing*/ /bkod pa chen po blo las 'das/ /ye shes rang snang gzhal med khang*/ /'ja' zer thig le'i mchod sprin dkrigs/ /sgyu 'phrul rgyan gyi rol mo ni/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i phung por spungs/ /phyi ltar nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga/ /lha rdzas bkra shis rtags rdzas dang*/ /rin chen rgyal srid rnam pa bdun/ /bum bzang nor bu dpag bsam shing*/ /ma rmos snye ma rin chen ri/ /'dod 'byung ba khyu zad med gter/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam las/ /grub pa'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /phung khams drwa ba sdom pa'i sman/ /'dod chags rnam dag ru dhi ra/ /rdo rje'i longs spyod ba liṃ ta/ /nang gi mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /rngams brjid dbang po lnga'i me tog /tshil gsur dud sprin zhun gyi me/ /shu rus zhal zas zhing glang gos/ /khrag 'thung rdzas kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /bde stong rdo rje'i rigs mchog gis/ /dga' bzhi'i sgyu rtsal cir yang ster/ /srung bzlog bsad pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyis/ /nyams pa rtsad gcod thugs dam bskang*/ /kun rdzob dbang yul chags sdang las/ /'das pa'i mchod sprin zad mi shes/ /don dam mchod bskang dmigs mtshan bral/ /mnyam nyid dgyes pas thugs dam bskang*/ /glo bur 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i las/ /snying nas bshags so byang dag nas/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs kun/ /dgyes pas dngos grub dpal kun stsol/ /bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs dpal 'phel zhing*/ /mtha' dmag dus kyi g.yo 'khrugs zhi/ /dpal kun dbang bsdus mthu stobs mes/ /log 'dren rtsad nas gcod par mdzod/ /rmad byung dgyes pa'i mchod sprin 'dis/ /brgyud gsum bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /khyad par gu ru che ba'i mchog /snang srid zil gnon thugs dam bskang*/ /bka' yi pho nya phrin las bzhi/ /sgrol ging chen po dregs pa'i gtso/ /ya ma rā dza bdud rkos rje/

/yaṃ shud gang bzang thugs dam bskang*/ /dkar phyogs skyongs shing rgyal bstan srung*/ /mtha' dmag dam sri'i srog gi gshed/ /lha srin sde dpon sum cu sogs/ /bka' sdod pho nya'i thugs dam bskang*/ /khyed rnams thugs rje'i rtsal bskyed la/ /snyigs ma'i dus kyi tha ma la/ /dben gnas chos 'khor 'jig la nye/ /hor sogs mtha' mi'i dmag gis gang*/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad pa'i tshe/ /smon log dam sri'i rgya 'dre choms/ /mtha' dmag rgyu 'grul rtsad nas chod/ /dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i ru mtshon sgrengs/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar mdzod/ /ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa dmag bzlog las rim dngos la/ dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni/ spros pa dang 'brel na slob dpon bdud chas su zhugs/ rkang gling dang bshugs glu sogs drag po'i rol mo dang zhing gi g.yab mo dang bcas pas bskul la gdung shugs bskyed de/ hūm̐: 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang dang : 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dur khrod nas: dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum dang chos skyong tshogs: sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag dpung dbyings nas bzhengs: da dus bskal pa snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir: bstan pa gnyan la sdang ba'i dgra dar na: le lo btang snyoms g.yel ba ma mdzad par: bstan dang bstan 'dzin bdag gi grogs la dgongs: chos kyi dbyings las sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar: rig 'dzin khrag 'thung lha tshogs skur ston pa: rnal 'byor mos pa'i gdung shugs bzod dka' bas: thugs dam rgyud bskul mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: gnyis pa gser skyems ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gser skyems zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ hūm̐: dkon mchog rin chen gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: khyad par rig 'dzin khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag gi mthu dang dpung bskyed cig: pho rgyud mo rgyud ma ning dregs pa'i sde:

ma mo mkha' 'gro zhing skyong gnas nyul kun: gser skyems bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag gi mthu dang dpung bskyed cig: lo zla zhag dus spar me tshes kyi bdag: yul lha gzhi bdag mthu rtsal ldan pa kun: gser skyems bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag gi mthu dang dpung bskyed cig: ces phud phyogs kun tu 'thor/ gsum pa gzu dpang ni/ hūm̐: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde gshegs rtsa ba gsum: rig 'dzin khrag 'thung sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha: rgyud gsum dregs pa'i dpung dang bcas pa rnams: ma g.yel ma g.yel gzu dang dpang mdzod cig: bdag gis byang chub lam la rab zhugs te: sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen spel ba dang : 'gro la phan bde bgyid par dam bcas kyang : dam nyams dgra dang bgegs kyi bar gcod na: ye shes thugs rje'i spyan gyis mi gzigs sam: sngon gyi thugs dam chen po rjes dgongs la: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs brlag pa'i phyir: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bzhi pa hom bskyed ni/ rang gi mdun du brub khung bang rim dgu pa/ kha khyer dog cing gting zab pa/ 'og gzhi gser gyi sa gzhi la zug pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs char 'bebs pa'i phyi rol du bka' srung dam can rnams las la rngams pa/ de'i nang du nṛ dang tri las gnod byed dgra bgegs nag la hom pa/ rkang lag lcags sgrog gis bsdom pa/ bu ga thams cad nas khrag 'dzag pa/ kha ngu ba/ mig shi mig /'o dod lhang lhang 'bod pa zhig tu gyur/ lnga pa bden stobs kyis 'gugs pa ni/ g.yab dril rgya bcas/ na mo rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags rig sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas dag kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/

khyad par du gu ru che ba'i che mchog pho nya dregs pa sde bzhi lha srin sde brgyad bka' srung pho nya dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra/ khyad par du bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la snga dgra lag gi brdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra thad du lang ba'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra/ gzugs med gnod byed kyi bgegs/ dben gnas chos 'khor gtsug lag 'dzin pa'i mtha' dmag 'byung po rgyab brten dang bcas pa'i bla srog rnam shes srid pa gsum gyi khong gar gnas gar bros kyang skad cig gis dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: ya du tsa sha rbad dzaḥ dgra bgegs mtha' dmag rgyab brten dam sri dang bcas pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a be sha ya a: zhes lan gsum gyis rten la bkug la/ drug pa bsgral ba'i las rim ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin che mchog bdud kyi gshed: khrag 'thung sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha: sprul pa yang sprul bka' sdod bcas: 'od gsal dbyings kyi ngang nyid las: ye shes gar dgu'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: rdo rje khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: chos kun sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang : gnas 'dir mngon spyod las la dgongs: 'bar ba chen po'i cho 'phrul las: sprul pa'i pho nya stong gsum khengs: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas mtshon cha so so'i brdeg zungs: zhags pa can gyis ske nas khrid: lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdom: dril bu'i lus sems myos su chug: ming byang 'di la myur du dbab pa'i rgya phobs: mgon skyabs byed pa'i lha dang bya 'ug gi sgros dbye rgya phyes: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul rtsad nas chod: thun brdeg phob cig drag tu rnam par gzir: gtad do gnyer ro byad du chug: rings par gyis la smyor chug cig:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: ya du tsa sha rbad dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pa sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ho: badz+ra a be sha ya a: badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭa: nā sha ya bhan+dha ya s+t+wam+bha ya mo ha ya phaṭa: bdun pa gdab kha dngos ni/ las phur phyag tu thog la drag sngags so lnga pa lan gsum gyis rak+tas byug /yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug pas gzi byin bskyed nas thal mo sbyar ba'i bar bsgril la/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rig 'dzin dpal chen po: khrag 'thung bdud 'dul bdud kyi gshed: sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las rdzogs: 'bar ba chen po'i gar gyis rol: lta ba blo 'das rdzong la gnas: bsgom pa 'od gsal 'phrang du 'jug: ye shes snying rje'i srog dang ldan: lag gnyis rigs lnga yab yum sbyor: mthing nag hūm̐ las skyes pa yi: sras mchog yak+sha kro dha ni: sku stod khro bo 'jigs pa la: sku smad phur pa'i dpal dang ldan: sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid can: 'phyar ba tsam gyis srid gsum 'dar: bsgril ba tsam gyis khams gsum brlag: klad la bskor bas bdag 'khor srung : sked la bskor bas phyir mi ldog: g.yas su bsgril bas pho rgyud 'dul: g.yon du bsgril bas mo rgyud 'dul: btab pas lha yang 'jigs 'gyur na: dgra dang bgegs la smos ci dgos: rdo rje khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: nyams pa'i snying gi dkyil du btab: dwangs ma drug po nyams par byas: tshe bsod lhar 'dus bdag la thim: dgra bgegs dug lnga kun sbyangs te: rnam shes phur pa'i khong nas brgyud: bde bar gshegs pa'i sras su gyur: 'od gsal dbyings kyi phyag rgyar rdzogs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: ya du tsa sha mā ra ya phaṭa bh+yoḥ a nṛ su tri pre duḥnṛ tri sha trūn bigh+nān mā ra ya phaṭa: ṇi bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥ a s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: zhes brjod tshig dang bstun pa'i phur bskor bya zhing tshe khrus gnas lung gi dgongs pa dang ldan pas sgrol phur gdab/

brgyad pa rdul du brlag pa ni/ hūm̐: ye shes 'bar ba'i ral gri 'dis: dam nyams dgra bgegs lnga phung rnams: phye mar dum bur gtub nas kyang : sha khrag dmar chen rgya mtshor bskyil: sarba sha trūn bigh+nān mā ra ya ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da bhin+dha bhin+dha rbad rbad: zhes sgrol gyis gtub/ dgu pa gtun du brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun: khro mo e yi dbyings nyid du: rdo rje khro bo'i gtun gyis brdungs: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: sarba sha trūn bigh+nān mā ra ya ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes tho btun gyis brdung*/ bcu pa zhal bstab ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin khrag 'thung lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: dgra bgegs dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab te 'bul: rngams brjid dgyes pa'i tshul du bzhes nas kyang*/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: byang chub lam gyi bar chad dbyings su sgrol: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs dpung bcas la: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sarba sha trūn bigh+nān mā ra ya ma hā maṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta king ni ri ti kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes sha khrag dang bcas bdud rtsis bran te 'bul/ las byang ltar tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma btang*/ bcu gcig pa bzlog pa'i phrin las gsol ba ni/ gtor chung dang sha dum ling ro bzlog gtor du 'bul bzhin pas/ bh+yo: gtum drag dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas nas: srid pa gsum gyi srog bdag chen po ni: gshin rje'i rgyal po ya ma rā dza khyed: rnal 'byor bdag gi myur du bskul lags na: ma thogs gshin rje'i dmag tshogs rab bsdus la: dam nyams dgra bo'i yul du jag par chos: dgra dpung rtsad chod bgegs dpung rdul du rlogs: bh+yo: mun pa nag po 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil na: srid pa gsum gyi dbang byed bdud kyi rje:

rkos rje drang dkar drag po'i las la bskul: bdud kyi dmag tshogs mang po myur du bsdus: dam nyams dgra yi yul du jag par chos: dgra dpung rtsad chod bgegs dpung thal bar rlogs: bh+yo: gri thabs me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: srid gsum 'jigs byed btsan gyi rgyal po ni: yam shud dmar po drag po'i las la bskul: dam nyams dgra yi yul du jag par chos: dgra dpung rtsad chod bgegs dpung rdul du rlogs: bh+yo: gdug rtsub rlung nag 'khyil ba'i gur khang nas: 'jig rten phung byed gnod sbyin kun gyi gtso: gang ba bzang po drag po'i las la bskul: dam nyams dgra yi yul du jag par chos: dgra dpung rtsad chod bgegs dpung rdul du rlogs:

bcu gnyis pa za lam bstan pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo: rig 'dzin khrag 'thung bka' nyan pa'i: snang srid lha 'dre'i dmag tshogs kun: la la dmag gi ru dar phyar: la la gsod pa'i mtshon rnon thogs: la la nad kyi rkyal pa phye: la la tshon gyi gru gu 'dril: la la bdud kyi zhags pa 'phen: la la sho rdel dkar nag 'phen: la la seng ge glang chen zhon: la la 'brug dang glog la zhon: la la 'brong chen dar ma zhon: la la stag gzig dom dred zhon: la la bya rgyal khyung la zhon: la la nam mkha'i khams nas 'phyo: la la sa gzhi khyab par nyul: la la chu bo'i gzhung nas rgyugs: la la ri bo'i rtse nas 'grim: la la dung chen ngar skad sgrogs: la la ku co bshugs glu len: la las rkan sgra drag po tog: la las rlung nag 'tshub ma 'dren: la las 'brug sgra drag po ldir: la las thog dang ser chen 'bebs: shin tu 'jigs shing gtum pa'i gzugs: dpal chen 'khor tshogs khyed rnams kyis: za lam dgra dang bgegs la phyes: sha khrag mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: chag che nyam nga byad phur sogs: mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad kun: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra la zlog: log par 'dren pa'i bgegs la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur drag po'i phrin las mdzod: bcu gsum pa bh+yo gdab pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo: da ni snang srid kun gyi bh+yo yis thob: chag che nyam nga thams cad dgra la bh+yo: lo skag zla skag thams cad dgra la bh+yo: za ma'i bdun zur thams cad dgra la bh+yo: rbod gtong rbad 'dre thams cad dgra la bh+yo: 'byung ba'i gtsug lag rtsub pa dgra la bh+yo: rtags dang rten 'brel ngan pa dgra la bh+yo: rmis ltas mtshan ngan thams cad dgra la bh+yo: yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa dgra la bh+yo: mas kyi sri ru langs pa dgra la bh+yo: bar gyi btsan thabs 'khrugs pa dgra la bh+yo: pha tshan rgya 'dre langs pa dgra la bh+yo: dar tshan stong 'dre g.yo ba dgra la bh+yo: ma bu'i byur 'dre 'khor ba dgra la bh+yo: phu nu'i rus 'dre gzing pa dgra la bh+yo:

ltag pa'i bdud du bab pa dgra la bh+yo: dpral pa'i gshed du 'khor ba dgra la bh+yo: rgyal po'i bka' chad 'bebs pa dgra la bh+yo: yul gyi kha mchu gleng ba dgra la bh+yo: sngags pa'i phur zor bsgril ba dgra la bh+yo: bon po'i rtse zor 'phen pa dgra la bh+yo: phyi pa'i ngan sngags thams cad dgra la bh+yo: nang pa'i bden tshig thams cad dgra la bh+yo: mtha' mi'i 'phrul 'khor bskaur ba dgra la bh+yo: drang srong dmod pa'i mtshon cha dgra la bh+yo: rang gshed rang la chags pa dgra la bh+yo: lha srung bdud du babs pa dgra la bh+yo: ma mo'i dal yams ngan pa dgra la bh+yo: lus kyi na tsha thams cad dgra la bh+yo: sems kyi zug rngu thams cad dgra la bh+yo: rta phyugs god kha ldang ba dgra la bh+yo: zhing gi btsa' sad ser gsum dgra la bh+yo: byur dang phung bshig ngan pa dgra la bh+yo: dus 'khrugs g.yul gshom ngan pa dgra la bh+yo: mtha' yi dmag dpung g.yo ba dgra la bh+yo: pho bdud dal kha thams cad g.yas su bh+yo: mo bdud dal kha thams cad g.yon du bh+yo: spyi bdud mi mthun phyogs kun mkha' la bh+yo: bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan thams cad dgra la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dgongs mor chos srung gtor skyong dang chad brtan nas shis brjod bar phrin las rdzogs par btang ba ni sgrub pa'i zhag grangs du byed pa la 'gres so/ /gsum pa rjes drag po'i g.yul 'gyed pa la gsum/ za lam bstan pa/ gtor zor 'phen pa/ 'jug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la drug /dang po sgrub zhag rdzogs pa'i nyin snga dro'i char khang steng nas bsang dang gser skyems brngan rnams bya/ zhal bstab kyi rjes su dkar byang me la bsregs/ sngags bzlog tshar ba'i rjes su slob dpon chas su zhugs la/ hūm̐ phaṭa dzaḥ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur: ces sngags rgyas btegs/ gnyis pa rig 'dzin bskul ba ni/

'chams stabs kyis bskor zhing*/ hūm̐: sngon tshe rgya gar rdo rje gdan: ghan+dho la yi pho brang du: paṇa chen lnga brgya tshogs nas su: sangs rgyas bstan pa spel ba na: mu stegs nag po g.yul bshams tshe: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: g.ya' ri'i nags la sgrub pa mdzad: bsnyen phur nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phar: rdo rje'i phyag rgyas blangs shing bsgril: bsgril shing tsan dan nags su 'phang : me 'bar 'khrug cing mtsho yang skem: srib kyi mu stegs sa gang bsreg: yak+sha nag po rdul du brlag: de bzhin bdag gis deng bskul gyi: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci: bdud sde 'dul ba'i grogs mdzod cig: gsum pa chad tho las byang ltar bsgrag /bzhi pa zor bskul ni/ hūm̐: drag po zor gyi dpung tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla mas rgyab brten mdzod: yi dam lha tshogs mngon spyod las la dgongs: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs rnams las la chos: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang ba'i dgra dar na: ma g.yel ma g.yel zor gyi dpung la gshegs: lnga pa phur kha bsgyur zhing zor lam bsal ba dngos la/ phur pa bsgril/ hūm̐: nga ni rak+sha thod phreng rtsal: dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las rdzogs: dpal chen po dang gnyis su med: de ring gdug pa'i zor 'phen gyi: lha gshegs gangs dkar rtse la gshegs: klu gshegs rgya mtsho'i gting la gshegs: btsan gshegs brag dmar ngos la gshegs: gdong du su yang ma sdod cig: de ring thams cad las la chos: bya khyung rgyal pos dmag sna drongs: rgyal chen bzhi yi shul mtshon te: mgon po'i tshogs kyi dmag dpon gyis: snang srid lha 'dre dmag la 'ur: phyogs skyong bcu yis ru mtshon phyor: sde dpon sum cu jag par rgyug: brtan ma rnams kyi so kha srung : rā hu la yis dkyil nas 'khyug: dbang phyug rnams kyis mtha' nas bsdus: khro bo'i tshogs kyis rting mnan te: pha rol bdud dang dgra bgegs la:

mngon spyod las kyi g.yul ngo sprod: bdud kyi ru dar bsnyil bar gyis: dgra dpung bdun brgyud rtsad nas chod: bgegs dpung thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlog: drug pa g.yul du zhugs pa ni/ gtor ma phyir dpag la/ bh+yo: zor gyi dpung tshogs bcas pa ni: srin po chas pa'i cho 'dra ste: srin zhal dmar po ya la la: 'brong dar chas pa'i cho 'dra ste: rtsang rnon ru thur zangs se zang : bdud rgyal chas pa'i cho 'dra ste: dar mdung mang po phya ra ra: ma mo chas pa'i cho 'dra ste: dug mtsho mang po nyi li li: ku bswo cha sgra di ri ri: spyi chag thams cad gtor mas bzlog: sgos chag thams cad khyung gis sgyur: zor gyi dmag dpung mkha' la gshegs: mi mthun thams cad bzlog pa dang : dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces lta ba'i gding*/ sgom pa'i gzengs bstod/ rig pa ngar phyung zhing*/ ging dkar nag gis ru dar phyar bas sna drangs pa'i zor rnams rim par btegs pa'i phyir 'brang zhing*/ rig 'dzin gyi lha tshogs dmag dpung 'ur dir gyis chas par bsam la/ khyams su sleb pa dang gtor ma phyir bzhag pa la/ gser skyems/ gzu dpang*/ phur bsgyur/ zlog pa/ za lam bstan pa/ bh+yo gdab rnams bya/ gang du 'phang ba'i gnas gza' rgod rgyu ba'i phyogs su zlog sngags bzlas shing phyin nas/ gnyis pa zor 'phen pa la lnga/ gser skyems gzu dpang phur bsgyur rnams sngar ltar dang*/ gnyis pa dmigs bya 'ben du byas la 'gugs gzhug bya/ gsum pa zor ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo: dpal chen khrag 'thung bka' nyan pa'i: lha srin sde brgyad dgra la bh+yo: stong gsum gangs ris bskor ba nas: gnod sbyin thams cad dgra la bh+yo: stong gsum zangs ris bskor ba nas: btsan dmag thams cad dgra la bh+yo: stong gsum lcags ris bskor ba nas: bdud dmag thams cad dgra la bh+yo: stong gsum brag ris bskor ba nas: srin po thams cad dgra la bh+yo: stong gsum g.yu ris bskor ba nas:

sman mo thams cad dgra la bh+yo: stong gsum gser ris bskor ba nas: gshin rje thams cad dgra la bh+yo: stong gsum dug mtsho 'khyil ba nas: klu bdud thams cad dgra la bh+yo: stong gsum khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa nas: ma mo thams cad dgra la bh+yo: stong gsum 'di na che ba yi: rgyal chen phyogs skyong dgra la bh+yo: hūm̐ bh+yo: nyams pa'i dgra bgegs dpung bcas la: rgyal chen bzhi yis yungs zor rgyob: gnod sbyin rnams kyis rdo zor rgyob: btsan dmag rnams kyis mda' zor rgyob: bdud rgyal rnams kyis kong zor rgyob: srin mo rnams kyis thod zor rgyob: sman mo rnams kyis mtshe zor rgyob: gshin rje rnams kyis khrag zor rgyob: klu bdud rnams kyis dug zor rgyob: ma mo rnams kyis khrag zor rgyob: lus ngag thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlog: ming tsam med par tshar chod cig: drag sngags bzla zhing zor rnams rol mo'i 'og tu 'phen/ bzhi pa gtor chen 'phen pa ni/ gtor ma'i dam tshig pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ gtor ma la chag sgo rkyen bgegs bstims pas nad mtshon dug gi rang bzhin du gyur par bsams nas/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo rgyal ba rnams: mchog gsum thugs dam ma g.yel cig: rig 'dzin byin rlabs dpung skyed cig: yi dam lha tshogs mthu ma chung : khro bo'i tshogs rnams rtsal ma zhan: chos skyong srung ma bang ma bul: dregs pa sde brgyad las la 'dus: gum gum chum chum dus la bab: gtor chen lag tu thogs nas/ hūm̐: nga ni dus gsum rgyal ba yi: mthu stobs nus pa'i ye shes sku: dbang drag rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang ba'i: dpal chen khrag 'thung bdud 'dul yin: de ring gdug pa'i gtor zor ni: phas rgol dmag tshogs 'joms phyir 'phen: sangs rgyas bstan bshig steng du 'phen: bla ma'i sku dgra rtsom la 'phen: dge 'dun 'du sgo 'phrog la 'phen: sems can sdug tu gtad la 'phen: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo yi:

gnam gyi 'ju thag gcod phyir 'phen: sa yi rten phur phud phyir 'phen: bar gyi dgra bgegs 'khor bcas kyi: bdun rgyud rtsad nas brlag phyir 'phen: mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad kun: sdang dgra gnod byed bgegs la zlog: ming tsam med par phung du chug: thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par gyis: drag sngags bzla zhing gtong zor rnams 'phang*/ dgra bgegs dam sri thams cad rtsa phung la me brgyab pa ltar shul med du brlag par bsam la/ dul mol rdab cing dmod mo 'ur/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rang la bstim/ lnga pa zor rjes gcod pa ni/ ye shes kyi bya khyung 'jigs su rung ba gcig gis mtshams bcad par bsam la/ hūm̐ khroṃ badz+ra ga ru ṭa bh+yo zlog: ces brjod la rdo rje slob dpon gyis rting mnan te tshur log /rdo rje'i gur du bdag gzhan bsrung bya thams cad tshud par bsam la las byang bzhin srung 'khor gsal btab/ de nas phyir snyegs gcod phyir gdong phyir bstan te/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bdud pra mā ra ya rbad nan: kha la dza ma li rbad nan: rā tsa du ling shag rbad nan: shig shig duṃ duṃ rbad nan: tshal pa tshal pa rbad nan: khroṃ khroṃ bh+yo rbad nan: rmug rmug rbad nan: tir tir rbad nan: tshal du tshal du rban nan: zhes nyer gcig bzla'o/ /gsum pa phrin las rjes kyi las rim sgo drung du/ brtan ma/ rta bro/ bkra shis bcas bya/ nang du phyin nas/ hrīḥ 'od gsal chos sku'i pho brang nas: longs spyod yongs rdzogs sprul pa'i sku: 'chi med rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: sgrub la tshe dbang mchog stsol phyir: thugs dam bskul lo dbyings nas bzhengs: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: bla tshe chad nyams yar ba dang : phyi snod 'byung ba bzhi yi bcud: nang bcud 'gro ba'i tshe bsod dpal: gsang ba rgyal ba sras bcas kyi: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan kun: 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rnam par bskul:

bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la bstim: rgas med lang tsho'i dngos grub stsol: nad med bde ba'i dngos grub stsol: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: ye shes mchog gi dngos grub stsol: tshe dzab bzlas la/ aḥ spros pas srid zhir khyab pa'i tshe: bsdus pas thig le nyag cig klong : 'pho 'gyur med par rgyas btab pas: ye shes chen po'i srog 'grub shog: dz+nyā na badz+ra rak+ṣa a: zhes rgyas gdab bya/ gtor chen gyi ye shes pa nam mkhar btegs pa dang*/ mdun bskyed dbyer med pa la gtang rag gi mchod bstod nongs pa bshags/ dngos grub len pa sogs rjes rim mtha' rgyas su bya/ nyin phyi ma la snang srid zhi bder sgrub pa'i bkra shis bsang gi cho ga sogs bya'o/ /gsum pa phyi nang gi 'khrugs pa zhi ba'i las rim ni/ bdag bskyed phyag rdor gyi gtor ma/ chos skyong gi mchod gtor/ sman raka nyer spyod bcas dang*/ rin po che'am rdza'i bum pa gru bzhi pa'i nang*/ rgyal chen yul 'khor srung gi sku bris 'bur gang 'grub la/ rang gzungs dang*/ oṃ gh+ṝ rā dza gh+ṝ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ zhes las sngags dang rten snying gi mthar/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung zhes bya ba sras dang btsun mo g.yog gi tshogs dang bcas pa'i mthu dang*/ stobs dang dbang phyug dang gzi brjid kyis gtsugs lag khang ngam/ rgyal po chen po che ge mo/ grong khyer 'di zhes bya ba'i yul sde 'khor dang bcas pa la mtha' yi dmag gi gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa ku ru bh+rūm̐ zhes 'dod gsol bcas/ steng du rgyal mtshan dkar po zhig btsugs pa'i tog gam srog shing gi nang du rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi gzungs tshar gsum dang*/ rten snying mthar/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i stobs kyis srung dgos skabs thob gang yin gyi ming bcug phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po'i gnod pa dang dmag dang*/ choms rkun dang dgra dang yul gzhan gyi rgyal pos kun nas 'tshe ba dang*/

gnod par sems pa thams cad srung shig rak+ṣa ku ru bh+rūm̐ zhes bris pa rnams dri bzang gis chus byugs te rab tu gnas/ rgyal chen sku'i mthar rin chen 'bru sman dar zab sogs mthun rdzas kyis phyur bur bkang la kha dam par bcad tshon skud sna lnga'i chings dang rtags gdab/ dge 'dun 'du ba'i gtsug lag khang dang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang gi sgo chen gyi steng du gter bum bzhag pa'am grong khyer chen po'i dbus su sku mkhar gru bzhi bcos pa'i dbus gter bum mi nyams pa'i btsas dang bcas te bzhag kyang rung*/ mdun du dkar gtor zas snas bskor ba dang nyer spyod mchod pa bcas bshams la/ steng du rgyal mtshan dkar po zhig btsugs la sbyang khrus byas pa sngon du 'gro bas rten la dmigs te mthun rdzas rnams gter bum spyi ltar sngags drug phyag drug gis byin brlabs bya/ sku dngos la/

a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa ni: rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i: pho brang rgyan bkod phun sum tshogs: yangs shing rgya che'i dbus nyid du: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du: dhṛ las sku rten yul 'khor srung : ljang gu phyag na pi waṃ bsnams: gru mor mdung dmar 'dzin pa'o: rin chen du ma'i rgyan gyis brgyan: spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga ru: dkar dmar mthing ba'i 'bru gsum dgod: mthing ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas: bsgoms pa 'dra ba'i ye shes pa: spyan drangs rten la thim par gyur: hūm̐: ri rab byang phyogs ro ldan yul: lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas: gnod sbyin gsang ba pa yi bdag: dpal chen phyag na rdo rje yang : 'gro ba'i don phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: shar phyogs skyong ba dri za'i bdag: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : yul 'khor srung gi grong khyer nas: dri za'i 'khor bcas gnas 'dir byon: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus: ma dag 'byor pa chung zhing ngan: mtshams med lnga ni kun spyod cing : thams cad nyon mongs 'dam bying bas: gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan yang : shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyed: thugs dam gang bzhes de dgongs la: 'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang : 'jig rten la ni sman slad du: rgyal chen 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ma hā rā dza dhṛṣ+ta raṣ+ta ya be ru dha ka ya: bi rū pāk+ṣā ya bai shrā ba ṇā ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir: nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni: ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na: de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis: mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa yis: gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang : khro bo'i dbang po khyed phyag 'tshal:

dri za dag gi bdag po che: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : btsun mo sras dang blon por bcas: de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba la: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung gis: bla med mchod pa ji bzhin du: de bzhin dpal chen gsang ba'i bdag: rgyal chen bzhi po 'khor bcas la: dngos 'byor yid las byung ba yi: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod: gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i dngos po kun: nam mkha'i mthar thug gang bar rnam sprul nas: ngo mtshar rmad byung mchod pa'i sprin phung tshogs: mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul: khyed cag 'byor pas phongs pa ma lags kyang : sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes bzhin: sangs rgyas bstan pa dam pa srung ba dang : sems can yongs su bskyab pa'i slad du bzhes: ma hā pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐: ma skyes chos dbyings dag pa'i ngang nyid las: ma 'gags rol pa 'jigs byed khro bo'i sku: bdud 'dul mthu stobs dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i khro mchog stobs po che: 'chol ba'i khro rgyal srid gsum bdud kyi dgra: drag shul thabs kyis bgegs dpung thal bar mdzad: 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa'i drag rtsal can: dpal chen dregs pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'jig rten skyong mdzad chos nyid bden par gzigs: tha tshig btsan pos thub pa'i bstan pa srung : pha rol dpung gis 'jigs pa thams cad srung : dri za'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung la bstod: rang rang 'khor g.yog sprul dang yang sprul bcas: kha ba bu yug 'tshubs 'dra stong gsum gang : sna tshogs gzugs can mi bsrun khro gtum can: rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong : 'jigs rung 'khor gyi tshogs la bdag bstod do: zhes bstod/ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar: sdig pa'i las rnams gang bgyis dang : khyad par rgyal po chen po bzhi'i:

thugs dang 'gal ba ci bgyis pa: gnong 'gyod sdom pa'i sems kyis bshags: yi ge brgya pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ de nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gi thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dngul dang*/ baiḍūr+ya dang*/ pad+ma rā ga dang*/ gser las grub pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa rim pa bzhin du bsams pa'i lte bar rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gi sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la: bdag phyag na rdo rje'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal ba las 'od 'phros pa'i rtse mo las mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod cing de dag la thim pas mnyes: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gi thugs ka nas las dang mthun pa'i kha dog can gyi 'od zer 'phros pas phrin las gang yin thogs med 'grub par bsam: oṃ dhṛṣ+tā raṣ+tā ya swā hā: rtsa sngags ci nus bzla/ thun mtshams su gtsang sbra dang ldan pas mdo sde gser 'od dam pa yang bklag /dkar gtor zlum po dkar gsum sogs zas snas bskor ba/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ yig las/ /byung ba'i rin chen snod yangs su/ /khaṃ las gtor ma bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /'dod yon sprin phung 'phro bar gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brlab/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ thog mar phyag rdor/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṝhan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha swā hā: lan gsum/ oṃ dhṛṣ+ta raṣ+tā ya swā hā: ma hā rā dza la ka wal sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ la liṃ ta sogs lan gsum/ rin chen las grub nam mkha' khyab pa'i snod: yi ge gsum gyi sbyor ba las byung ba'i:

ye shes bdud rtsis nam mkha'i khams bkang ste: 'dod yon drug gi mchod pa'i sprin phung 'phro: ro mchog yon tan kun dang ldan pa yi: zag med bde ster gtor ma'i mchod pa 'di: dpal chen mngon rdzogs phyag na rdo rje dang : bstan pa'i srung ma rgyal po chen po bzhi: btsun mo sras dang blon 'khor bcas pa la: gus pas 'bul lo 'gro ba'i don du bzhes: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: gong gi mchod pa ltar mchod la/ shar phyogs na ni gnas srung po: 'jig rten skyong ba gzi brjid ldan: shar phyogs dag ni skyong byed pa: rdzu 'phrul che la stobs kyang che: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas dang : che ge zhes bya ba'i yul 'di ru: bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang : dngos grub ma lus stsol ba dang : khyad par mtha' dmag du ru ka: zlog cing 'byung ba med par mdzod: ces sogs 'dod gsol gang shes bya'o/ /mthar brtan bzhugs rab gnas bya'o/ /gter bum kho na yin na sgrub tshul snga ma bzhin byas la gtsug lag khang ngam/ pho brang gi shar sgor gter bum bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ steng du rgyal mtshan btsugs la cho ga tshar gcig bskyar zhing rab gnas brtan bzhugs shis brjod rgyas par byas kyang rung zhing*/ dus bzang sogs su mchod sgrub yang yang bya ba gal che'o/ /dus mthar mtshon gyi bskal me'i dbal/ /'joms byed gu ru'i pha nor dbyig /lhag bsam rgyal mtshan rtser 'phyar bas/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal thob shog /ces thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i man ngag bcu gsum gyi dang po gu ru hor sogs dmag bzlog gi phrin las ste le'u tshan gnyis pa'o// //
